svg.title: Reward models learn from pairwise preferences
svg.desc: A reward model scores a prompt-response pair with a scalar. Human or AI preference labels form (x,y+,y−) pairs. Bradley–Terry predicts preference with sigmoid(r+−r−), and training minimizes the negative log-sigmoid of the reward gap.

g.text: Reward models learn from pairwise preferences
Bradley–Terry turns a reward gap into a preference probability.
PREFERENCE DATA → SCALAR REWARDS → COMPARISON LOSS
At inference, score one response. KL to the reference helps limit reward hacking.
